Lebanese Loto - Statistical Analysis

Draws 1-2458 (2447 draws, 2002-09-12 to 2026-10-15)

Every chart compares the real history against the exact or simulated behaviour of a fair 6/42 lottery. Deviations are only meaningful if they exceed what fair draws produce and survive multiple-testing correction.

3. Randomness test battery

4. Monte Carlo comparison: real history vs fair histories of the same length

Each row compares a statistic of the real history with its distribution across 10,000 simulated fair histories of exactly the same length. Extremes such as the hottest number, the longest absence or the most frequent pair are judged against the extremes of fair histories, which accounts for having searched across all numbers and pairs.
